title: Spiced Chickpea Orecchiette
style: Glossy, flavour-layered pasta with spiced chickpeas and fresh herbs
description: Orecchiette tossed in a naturally creamy chickpea sauce with warm spices, lemon, capers, and fresh herbs.
steps: Cook the Pasta: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and cook orecchiette until al dente. Reserve at least 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add red onion with a pinch of salt and cook until soft and lightly golden. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, smoked paprika, cumin, fennel seeds, cinnamon, and chilli flakes. Cook 3–4 minutes until fragrant and hot.
Crush roughly half the chickpeas in the pan using the back of a spoon to create a rough, creamy base.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook until they soften and burst. Add lemon zest and a splash of pasta water to deglaze, stirring to form a glossy sauce.
Add greens and let them wilt. Stir in capers (or olives) and miso or nutritional yeast until fully dissolved.
Add cooked pasta and toss well, adding more pasta water as needed until the sauce clings to the orecchiette.
Remove from heat and finish with lemon juice, lots of black pepper, chopped parsley and basil, and a drizzle of chilli oil.
tips: Crushing chickpeas is key — it replaces cream and makes the sauce cling.
Cinnamon should be barely perceptible; it adds warmth, not sweetness.
Always finish pasta off the heat to keep lemon and herbs bright.
